meta.title: An app that sometimes tells you to change nothing.
meta.status: DRAFT — not publish-ready until compliance-reviewer PASS is on record

slides.heading: Another week, another change to your plan.
slides.supporting: Even when nothing in your data actually moved.

slides.heading: Change things too often and you cannot tell what actually worked.
slides.supporting: Every extra tweak muddies the picture.

slides.heading: Volyume works differently.
slides.supporting: It reads your logged training and food and makes one weekly call, change or hold.

miniCard.reason: Need at least 3 morning weights for a reliable trend.

slides.heading: When there is not enough to go on, it holds and tells you why.
slides.supporting: No change gets made without a reason you can read.

appShot.label: Your plan, changed only with a reason.

slides.heading: It tells you when to hold and why, not only when to push.
slides.supporting: The weekly coaching is part of Pro.

monoStat.caption: Free to start, on Google Play.
